title: Presentation Trainer: What Experts and Computers Can Tell About Your Nonverbal Communication
metricDefinition: The abstract describes expert-derived nonverbal communication practices and a multimodal feedback prototype, without exposing a transferable scoring formula.

measurements.definition: Expert-identified practices used to reason about public-speaking feedback.
notes: The abstract does not define capture-quality metrics.

reportedFindings.summary: The abstract supports human-expert grounding and warns that automated presentation feedback needs a valid assessment model.

faceFitMappings.reason: Audio clipping is a capture-quality condition, not a public-speaking behavior rubric item.

thresholdAssessment.reason: Expert practices require operationalization and reliability validation before any numeric scoring.

limitations: Only the official abstract was reviewed.
Expert practices are not interchangeable with raw sensor metrics.
